inputs.original_text: KTR is accusing the Congress government of letting illegal mining continue while a company he says belongs to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved. That looks less like an isolated failure and more like the sort of protection insiders get when powerful interests are involved. The account is only a fragment, but even the accusation points to a convenient arrangement: public inaction, private benefit, and a political system that would rather control the story than confront it.
inputs.modified_text: This sounds like the familiar arrangement: illegal mining carries on, a company KTR says belongs to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is implicated, and the Congress government is accused of looking away. That kind of inaction is hard to dismiss as an ordinary oversight when powerful interests may benefit. The accusation may be only a fragment, but the rush to manage the story instead of confront the allegation is exactly what makes the whole setup look protected.
